prompts.prompt: Create one new seamless game texture of traditional Chinese linghua (菱花) floral wooden window lattice. Square 512 x 512 target. Both horizontal AND vertical tiling must be seamless: lattice bars, their widths, colors and cutout shapes continue at exactly corresponding positions across opposite edges. No outer window frame; this image is a repeatable section of the lattice itself, extending through all four borders. Orthographic straight-on view, purely flat unlit base-color texture: no bevel shading, no highlights, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no light gradient. Fine natural wood pigment, no raised relief. CRITICAL: genuine transparent alpha background, every hole between bars is completely transparent, not white, black, gray, frosted glass or a painted checkerboard. Only the wooden lattice is opaque, softly antialiased edge pixels allowed. No wall, scenery, backing board, curtain, perspective, labels or text. One complete raster PNG asset with real alpha holes, not a preview/mockup.
